messages:
alex: Quick mid-week checkpoint on SOC2/ISO milestones — calling out owners and short asks so we can lock dates. High-level: KMS attestation, HSM test plan, audit-log retention/ingest proof, and a small schema change to add key_id to app logs. Who's owning which and ETA?

maria: I can take the KMS attestation doc and the key rotation notes. Will drop a draft in #eng-security by EOD Friday.

san: cc @eng-infra — we own the HSM test harness and staging rotation. Working on infra runbook, target next Wed for run-through.

jordan: I can own audit-log ingest evidence and retention config (CloudWatch -> S3 pipeline). Need one leaning PR from apps to show metadata. ETA: next Tue.

pat: For compliance timeline: auditors want the evidence packet two weeks before fieldwork. If draft artifacts land Fri and tests Wed, we should be good. Please flag any blockers by Monday. :calendar:

alex: thanks — can we break down action items so automation/compliance teams can slot them? Quick asks: (1) maria: include attestation checklist + KMS config snippet, (2) san: HSM test matrix + runbook, (3) jordan: sample S3 object with retention headers, (4) apps: tiny PR with key_id in logs and a note about hashing.

maria: noted. I'll include the KMS CMK metadata and the CLI commands to fetch key metadata. snippet:```sh
# show key policy
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy my-key --location=global --keyring=redwood-keys
```

san: HSM runbook will include the test steps and failback. One open question — do we need a dedicated HSM cluster per region for auditproofing, or is cross-region replication OK?

jordan: cross-region replication is fine for DR, but auditors ask for proof of separation of duties. If we rely on replication, include RBAC matrix and who performed each rotation step in the logs.

alex: good call. maria, can you add an ownership matrix line for rotations so the auditors can see roles? e.g., "Ops: rotate, Sec: approve, Audit: observe"

maria: yup will add. Also adding examples of signed attestations and a minimal Policy ID snippet.

devsec-bot: Reminder: SOC2 evidence due date set to 2144835200 in the compliance calendar. Automated checklist updated: KMS attestation, HSM test logs, audit-log S3 objects, app log schema PR.

pat: small ask from compliance team — for the audit packet we need one example of an S3 object path and timestamp, plus a SHA256 hash proof. jordan can you stash an example in the evidence bucket?

jordan: on it. I'll upload a sample object `s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/v2026-03-xx/auditlog-example.json` with sha256 in metadata and link in the ticket.

alex: apps teams — please open a tiny PR that adds `key_id` to the structured log payload and references the ticket INF-2345. Minimal change, unit test covering serialization. Link back here when open.

maria: also want a quick code review on the attestation template. @alex you cool to eyeball?

alex: yep i'll review tomorrow morning. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.

san: timeline summary: HSM runbook Wed, KMS attestation Fri, audit ingest example Tue, app PR asap — sounds reasonable.

pat: perfect. I'll draft the evidence checklist email to auditors after we have the three artifacts.

alex: thanks all — one follow-up: jordan/maria, can you split any long-lived creds used in tests into short-lived tokens and document TTL in the runbook? auditors will want that.

jordan: will do, adding TTLs to the pipeline docs.

maria: I'll call out ephemeral creds in the attestation and include how we revoke test keys.

alex: great. If nobody objects I'll convert this thread into a short action-task card and assign owners. :thumbsup:

pat: no objections. thanks everyone.

jordan: opened INF-2345 with the app PR checklist and linked the sample S3 object — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345

alex: marking this thread resolved for async sync; reopen if anything slips.
